node.title: L1 tame-refinement periodic-owner obstruction
node.statement: On H=F_17^* with n=16, k=8, sigma=5, ell=6, the petal T={1,2,3,11,12,13} is the union of three complete fibers of the tame degree-two map P=X^2+3X. Taking core C={7,8,9,10,14,15,16}, remainder R={4,5,6}, and U zero on A=C union T and one on R, the zero codeword has exact agreement set A of size k+sigma. Yet Stab_H(A)=Stab_H(R)={1}. Thus a tame fixed-petal polynomial refinement does not force exact multiplicative periodicity or intrinsic cyclic quotient descent. The small-scale branch needs a general polynomial-pullback owner or collective aperiodic-support payment. This toy is a route fence, not an official-row L1 counterexample.
